name: Mikado Taeko
source:
Taeko is [url=/c10764]Chihaya[/url]'s [spoiler] and [url=/c10950]Chitose[/url]'s [/spoiler] mother. She makes her son transfer to Seio Girls' Academy from which she graduated.

[spoiler]Taeko sometimes thinks Chihaya is Chitose because she had forgotten about Chitose's death because it affected her mind. She is doted upon by Chihaya after that. [/spoiler]

[Taken from [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_Otome_wa_Boku_ni_Koishiteru_characters#Otome_wa_Boku_ni_Koishiteru:_Futari_no_Elder]Wikipedia[/url].]
